title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical runtime safety enforcement for LLM agents, specifically targeting code vulnerabilities, physical hazards in robotics (SafeAgentBench), and traffic law compliance in autonomous driving. While it mentions 'ethical use' as a broad goal of safety, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks/reasoning.
